text: 5.1 Foreign Medical Examination Forms. 5.2 Certificate of English or Chinese Proficiency. 5.3 Copy of passport (a valid ordinary passport) and one passport-sized photo. 5.4 Undergraduate applicants, educational qualification certificates, original or notarized copies (in English or Chinese); for those who are still in their final year of study, they should provide proof of expected graduation. 5.5 For graduate applicants, the following academic materials are required: original or notarized copies of the undergraduate transcript and bachelor's degree certificate (in either English or Chinese), two recommendation letters from different referees (in Chinese or English), and at least an associate professor (or equivalent title) position. 5.6 The academic materials required for doctoral program applicants are: the original or notarized copy of the student's academic transcript and the master's degree certificate (in either English or Chinese), two recommendation letters from different professors, published papers, and the research plan for pursuing a doctoral degree in China. 5.6 Self-funded international students should designate a trustee in China and provide financial guarantee (international students who do not receive support from the Jiangsu Provincial Government Scholarship are classified as self-funded full-time graduate students).
